meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览并选择性合并上游 NanoClaw 更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要高效管理 NanoClaw 的定制安装更新，支持预览和选择性应用。
copy.tagline_en: Preview and selectively apply upstream updates to your NanoClaw install.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage updates to a customized NanoClaw installation with preview and selective cherry-pick.

howto.what: 当你说「/update-nanoclaw」,Claude 会检查工作区是否干净、备份、预览上游更新,让你选合并或挑选,再解决冲突、运行构建与测试,并提示破坏性变更。它只打开冲突文件以节省用量。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 `/update-nanoclaw` 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我更新 NanoClaw 到最新版
say.note: Claude 会先备份并预览,然后询问你选哪种更新方式。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw,先只给我看更新预览
say.note: 选择 Abort 路径,只查看变更不改动代码。

say.text: 用 cherry-pick 只合并指定的上游提交
say.note: 提供提交哈希后,Claude 仅挑选这些提交并解决冲突。

howto.what_en: When you run `/update-nanoclaw`, Claude checks the working tree is clean, creates a backup, previews upstream changes, offers merge or cherry-pick, resolves conflicts, runs build/tests, and flags breaking changes. It only opens conflicted files to save tokens.
howto.when_en: When you invoke the `/update-nanoclaw` command in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Help me update NanoClaw to the latest version.
say_en.note: Claude backs up, previews, then asks how to proceed.
Choose Abort to see the changelog without editing.
Give hashes; Claude applies only those, resolving conflicts.
